observation: An empty left click opened a flamethrower area preview; a second click could fire.
clarification: The user explicitly allows ordinary area weapons to aim and fire at empty ground.
conclusion: The reproduced flamethrower case is expected. No unintended skill cast was reproduced with single-target weapons.

normal_game.single_target_melee_and_ranged: empty clicks do not arm or fire, spend resources, advance turns or reuse another selected enemy
normal_game.ordinary_area_weapon: empty click opens ordinary preview; confirmation records AttackAt, never an unselected TechniqueAt
normal_game.selected_skill: left click still confirms; right click cancels
